description.zh: 最后开 React hook。useAutoAnimate 和 Add number 按钮就是可复制证明。 FormKit 的零配置动效工具，一行代码即可在 React、Vue 等框架给 DOM 增删改加过渡。仓库 LICENSE 为 MIT，可免费用于个人与商业项目。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by AutoAnimate (https://auto-animate.formkit.com/).
Technology stack: javascript, typescript, react, vue.
Component specification: 最后开 React hook。useAutoAnimate 和 Add number 按钮就是可复制证明。

Visual details from source observation: 打开 auto-animate.formkit.com，标题 Add motion to your apps with a single line of code，代码块 import { useAutoAnimate } from '@formkit/auto-animate/react'。Usage 节说明 autoAnimate 绑在父节点，子节点增删改时触发。React hook 页给出 useAutoAnimate 与 Add number / Disable。单页站点，#usage 与 #usage-react 才是真正不同的证据段。MIT。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
